high_level_description: A science fiction book cover artwork, portrait format, a lone ship above a ringed planet with a metallic title, presented flat and front-on as cover artwork, filling the frame edge to edge, centered symmetrical composition, the planet fills the lower half, the ship sits upper left, the title occupies the upper third.

style_description.aesthetics: quiet vastness, a single ship a long way from home
style_description.lighting: rim light, from behind the planet, hard direct light with crisp shadow edges, cool color temperature, blue cast
style_description.art_style: wide shot, full body in the environment, shot at eye level, neutral perspective, 50mm lens, true-to-eye perspective, f8, cinematic

compositional_deconstruction.background: a deep indigo to black gradient with fine star field, no border, no mockup, no physical book

elements.desc: a wide brushed-metal serif title in pale silver, letter spaced across the upper third of the cover
